description: Single-host control: raw virtio-blk image file on the experiment XFS through QEMU's direct io_uring backend (cas-native-run --backend raw). g1 runs; g4/g8/g16 are blocked until cas-native-run boots more than two guests.

r6615.note: cpus 24-31 and SMT siblings 32-63 left idle; irq/daemon/guest sets on distinct physical cores 0-23

c6525-25g.note: with SMT on, 16-23 are siblings of 0-7; disable SMT or shrink the guest list if the inventory shows 16 logical cpus

loopback-8.note: development: both members on one 8-vCPU VM, as in the 2026-11-13 harness validation
